_about: What LEGO Pick a Brick actually sells, learned from list uploads (elementId,quantity) and from looking elements up on lego.com. Element IDs are chosen newest-first from Rebrickable's elements, except: IDs inside an avoid range are skipped when the part/colour has another ID; `use_instead` swaps an ID Pick a Brick rejected for one it sells; `unavailable` IDs are left out of pick_a_brick.csv (buy those on BrickLink). Verified by uploading the VHS Cassette list on 2026-09-30.
_avoid_ranges: Every element tested from this block (11 White parts, 2026-09) was unavailable on Pick a Brick while an older ID for the same part/colour was available.
_use_instead: 4121715 (Technic Pin with Friction, 2780, Black) is not on Pick a Brick; the same pin is, as 6279875 (LEGO's design 61332, 'CONNECTOR PEG W. FRICTION'), looked up 2026-10-13.
_bestseller: Pick a Brick ships its Bestseller pieces together within days and its Standard pieces later, in a parcel of their own: a kit that should arrive as one parcel is all Bestsellers. `bestseller` and `standard` are element IDs as lego.com listed them (US shop) on the date in `bestseller_checked`: the site's search answers with deliveryChannel 'pab' for a Bestseller and 'bap' for a Standard piece. Nothing reads these lists yet; they are a record. An ID in neither list has not been looked up.
